observations.classification: independent bounded confirmation of ROOT-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-014 and previous rand packet; no new unique finding
observations.trace: For u64 the widening helper multiplies two u64 values in u128 and returns high and low 64-bit words; (2^64−1)^2 is below 2^128. Generic Rng::random dispatches StandardUniform, whose u64 implementation invokes next_u64; the concrete UniformInt sampler compares the low word with a threshold and retries rejected values. Project DeterministicRng constructs this sampler with a nonzero exclusive upper bound.
observations.condition: This is a source/mathematical argument for the selected u64 path, not execution, statistical certification, a proof of random-word quality, or a guarantee of one word per sample. SIMD, other widths, single-sample and other Rng methods are not covered. Native macro definitions/invocations were read as text only.
observations.future_repair_direction: Maintain fixed-width draws and existing error/seed/order semantics when reconciling the actual consumer contract; rejection can consume multiple full-width words.

observations.classification: conditional native precondition, not an observed project defect or unique count
observations.trace: The rejection loop has no fixed iteration limit. For upper u64::MAX the threshold is 1, and a hypothetical RngCore returning zero forever yields a zero low product and never passes the rejection comparison.
observations.condition: This is mathematical reasoning about an arbitrary native trait implementation; the project uses SplitMix64, whose actual state transition was not inspected here. No observed hang, reachable current caller, simulated generator or test is asserted. Do not count generic random-source semantics as a product failure without evidence.
